content.title: KLIC Q2 Deep Dive: Core Market Improvement Offsets Automotive Weakness, Guidance Surprises to Upside
content.summary: Semiconductor production equipment company Kulicke & Soffa (NASDAQ: KLIC) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2025, but sales fell by 18.3% year on year to $148.4 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.07 per share was 27.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
